Class RowSetOps

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.RowSetOps
public class RowSetOps extends Object
Utility class for working with RowSets and ResultSets. Some methods for converting to/from text from/to objects according to database type. Several convenience methods for accessing metadata.
Since:
4.0.0

      public static <T> T getColumnObject(RSC comp, Class<T> type) throws SQLException
      Returns an Object of the specified type representing the value in the component's bound database column. This may involve a conversion.

      Note that if a String type is specified, a null is not automatically turned into "" use getColumnObjectText for that.

      Type Parameters:

      comp - component
      type - Class of returned type

    • updateColumnText

      public static RowSetOps.DbUpdate updateColumnText(SsComponent comp, String updatedValue) throws SqlNullException, SQLException, NumberFormatException
      The String updatedValue is converted to an object and ResultSet.updateObject(int, java.lang.Object) or ResultSet.updateNull(int) is used.

      When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change to the database.

      Parameters:
      comp - The SsComponent doing the update
      updatedValue - string to be type-converted as needed and updated in underlying RowSet column
      Returns:
      actual item written to the database, throws if nothing written
      Throws:
      SqlNullException - thrown if null is not allowed
      SQLException - thrown if a database error is encountered
      NumberFormatException - thrown if unable to parse a string to number format

    • updateColumnObjectDirect

      public static void updateColumnObjectDirect(RowSet rowSet, int columnIndex, Object value) throws SQLException
      Update the Grid's RowSet at the specified column index with the given Object value. RowSet. Operate on the current row.

      When the user changes/edits the SSDataGrid cell this method propagates the change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change to the database.

      Parameters:
      rowSet - RowSet on which to operate
      columnIndex - index of the database column
      value - string to be type-converted as needed and updated in underlying RowSet column
      Throws:
      SQLException - thrown if a database error is encountered
